programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Kemesraan yang dipamerkan oleh Haziq dan Aisyah sebagai pasangan kekasih membuakkan rasa iri hati pada Iskandar. Perubahan itu di kesan apabila Iskandar banyak mempersoalkan tentang layanan yang diberikan pada Haziq tidak pernah dirasainya. Aisyah terasa bahagia dengan apa yang di dengarnya dari mulut Iskandar. Dia tidak pernah menyangka bahawa Iskandar akan menunjukkan rasa cemburu di depannya. Tengku Maria memperkenalkan Tengku Waiduri kepada Aisyah. Saat itu, Aisyah pula terpaksa melihat kemesraan Iskandar dengan Tengku Waiduri. Tanpa pengetahuan Aisyah, Iskandar sudah memaklumkan hal itu pada Tengku Waiduri, tetapi bukan tentang status mereka sebagai suami isteri tetapi perasaan Iskandar sendiri terhadap Aisyah. Tengku Waiduri yang sudah masak dengan perangai Tengku Maria menyokong penuh tindakan Iskandar agar terus menyembunyikan status mereka sehingga tiba masa yang sesuai. Aisyah memakai gaun yang cantik pada malam itu, mereka makan bersama di rumah Tengku Maria, disebabkan rasa sakit hati melihat kemesraan Iskandar dan Tengku Waiduri, Aisyah membawa diri ke ruangan lain dan disebabkan tidak biasa dengan kasut tumit yang tinggi bersama gaun yang labuh, Aisyah tersadung lalu terjatuh di dalam kolam renang di rumah Tengku Maria. Terkejut dengan insiden itu, Iskandar bergegas menyelamatkan Aisyah.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Syarfan berasa tenang setelah berkongsi kisah hitam dalam hidupnya hingga meyebabkan dia sukar tidur malam kepada Antasya. Syarfan turut meluahkan bahwa dia menyukai Antasya sejak pertama kali mereka bertemu. Bot datang menyelamatkan mereka. Antasya nekad membawa pulang ayahnya setelah mengetahui keadaan ayahnya dari Najwan. Sejak dari itu Syarfan sering mencari peluang untuk berjumpa Antasya walau seketika. Cinta mereka mula berputik.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Dengan niat hanya sementara, Qasih menerima saje perancangan ibunya untuk pergi Umrah di bawah tunjuk ajar Jazlan semasa di Tanah Suci nanti. Namun kesabaran Jazlan sangat-sangat tercabar dengan kerenah Qasih yang banyak membuang masa dengan berehat dan tidur di bilik dari mengerjakan ibadah di masjid

programme.title: Cinta Dalam Sekam

programme.desc: Dulang Boy mengisahkan tentang seorang budak lelaki berusia 10 tahun bernama Kerol Lazania KL yang teruja kerana dipilih menjadi dulang boy untuk majlis perkahwinan kakaknya, Ros. Tugasnya adalah membawa dulang berisi sepasang kasut yang dianggap sangat Istimewa. programme.desc: Syarfan berasa tenang setelah berkongsi kisah hitam dalam hidupnya hingga meyebabkan dia sukar tidur malam kepada Antasya. Syarfan turut meluahkan bahwa dia menyukai Antasya sejak pertama kali mereka bertemu. Bot datang menyelamatkan mereka. Antasya nekad membawa pulang ayahnya setelah mengetahui keadaan ayahnya dari Najwan. Sejak dari itu Syarfan sering mencari peluang untuk berjumpa Antasya walau seketika. Cinta mereka mula berputik.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Dengan niat hanya sementara, Qasih menerima saje perancangan ibunya untuk pergi Umrah di bawah tunjuk ajar Jazlan semasa di Tanah Suci nanti. programme.title: Cinta Dalam Sekam
programme.desc: Rancangan Sarah untuk bertemu keluarga mencetuskan rasa ingin tahu Alia tentang niat sebenarnya. Imran berasa terperangkap dan tidak berdaya, manakala Laila menemui harapan pada saat yang paling tidak diduga. Sementara itu, satu pendedahan mengejutkan membuatkan Shafiq terpinga-pinga.

programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Meskipun Farah sedang menunggu saat diijabkabulkan, namun dia masih dalam dilema untuk menjadi isteri Lukman. Dia masih keliru dengan keputusannya antara amanah arwah Sarah dengan keikhlasannya menerima abang iparnya sebagai suami. Baik Lukman mahupun Farah, kedua-duanya terpaksa maniskan wajah di majlis pernikahan mereka demi menjaga hati Zahin dan kedua-dua orang tua. Di sebalik kegembiraan, ada hati yang tercarik luka dengan pernikahan mereka. Lantaran terlalu kecewa, Myra sanggup bertindak di luar kawalan hingga menyebabkannya kemalangan dan koma. Joshua muncul untuk membantu Myra lalu membawanya ke hospital. Lukman pula resah kerana tidak dapat menjejak Myra setelah Myra hilang begitu sahaja ketika majlis pernikahannya berlangsung. Farah kecewa apabila Lukman berterus terang yang dia takkan menyentuh Farah kerana dia hanya setia dan cintakan arwah isterinya, Sarah.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Kemesraan yang dipamerkan oleh Haziq dan Aisyah sebagai pasangan kekasih membuakkan rasa iri hati pada Iskandar. Perubahan itu di kesan apabila Iskandar banyak mempersoalkan tentang layanan yang diberikan pada Haziq tidak pernah dirasainya. Aisyah terasa bahagia dengan apa yang di dengarnya dari mulut Iskandar. Dia tidak pernah menyangka bahawa Iskandar akan menunjukkan rasa cemburu di depannya. Tengku Maria memperkenalkan Tengku Waiduri kepada Aisyah. Saat itu, Aisyah pula terpaksa melihat kemesraan Iskandar dengan Tengku Waiduri. Tanpa pengetahuan Aisyah, Iskandar sudah memaklumkan hal itu pada Tengku Waiduri, tetapi bukan tentang status mereka sebagai suami isteri tetapi perasaan Iskandar sendiri terhadap Aisyah. Tengku Waiduri yang sudah masak dengan perangai Tengku Maria menyokong penuh tindakan Iskandar agar terus menyembunyikan status mereka sehingga tiba masa yang sesuai. Aisyah memakai gaun yang cantik pada malam itu, mereka makan bersama di rumah Tengku Maria, disebabkan rasa sakit hati melihat kemesraan Iskandar dan Tengku Waiduri, Aisyah membawa diri ke ruangan lain dan disebabkan tidak biasa dengan kasut tumit yang tinggi bersama gaun yang labuh, Aisyah tersadung lalu terjatuh di dalam kolam renang di rumah Tengku Maria. Terkejut dengan insiden itu, Iskandar bergegas menyelamatkan Aisyah.

programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Farah rasa kepenatan namun dia cuba menyesuaikan diri sebagai isteri dan ibu kepada Zahin. Urusan harian sebagai surirumah agak melelahkan. Namun dia bahagia apabila guru tadika Zahin memberitahu akan perubahan positif Zahin selepas Farah menggantikan tempat arwah Mamanya. Farah mula rasa terkilan dan dalam dilema apabila Liza dan Nazim sudah membuat permohonan untuk melanjutkan pengajian peringkat Master di Universiti Manchester. Joshua pula mula rapat dengan Myra dan mengambil berat akan kebajikan Myra. Dia berpakat dengan Myra untuk mengenakan Lukman setelah mengetahui siapa sebenarnya lelaki yang dibenci Myra itu. Lukman bengang apabila Farah tidak mengambil Zahin di tadika sedangkan Farah kepenatan menguruskan hal ehwal rumahtangga. Farah terkilan kerana Lukman menuduhnya pura-pura sakit dan banyak beralasan. Budi terkejut apabila Myra tiba-tiba muncul di pejabat.

programme.title: Gateway
programme.desc: Sekumpulan penjenayah terdesak mencari perlindungan di rumah yang kelihatan seperti rumah biasa - tetapi mendapati ia menempatkan sesuatu yang jauh lebih jahat, dan lebih dunia lain, daripada yang mereka sangkakan pada mulanya

programme.title: Domino
programme.desc: Selepas bapanya, seorang ketua jenayah Vietnam yang berkuasa di Amerika Syarikat dibunuh secara kejam, tanpa diduga menjadi sasaran sindiket saingan. Terpaksa melangkah ke dunia berbahaya yang selalu dielakkannya.

programme.title: Dabbe Bir Cin Vakasi
programme.desc: Rumah sebuah keluarga di Turki dirasuk roh jahat yang ingin membunuh manusia.

programme.title: Three Days To Kill
programme.desc: Seorang ejen perisikan antarabangsa yang berbahaya bertekad untuk meninggalkan kehidupannya yang penuh risiko demi membina hubungan yang lebih rapat dengan isteri dan anak perempuannya yang telah lama terpisah. Tetapi terlebih dahulu, dia perlu menyelesaikan satu misi terakhir - walaupun itu bermakna dia perlu menguruskan dua tugas paling sukar setakat ini: memburu pengganas paling kejam di dunia dan menjaga anak perempuannya yang remaja buat pertama kali dalam sepuluh tahun, sementara isterinya tiada di bandar.

programme.title: The Lift
programme.desc: Selepas sahabat baiknya hilang, seorang gadis kolej yang menghidap klaustrofobia mula menyiasat lif misteri tempat rakannya kali terakhir dilihat lif yang mungkin merupakan pintu ke dunia gelap yang menakutkan.

programme.title: Hani
programme.desc: Hani ialah seorang pelukis manga junior yang kembali ke Malaysia tetapi menghadapi masalah dengan tugasan terbarunya yang berkaitan dengan seorang patung berhantu.

programme.title: Dont Blink
programme.desc: Sepuluh orang tiba di sebuah pusat peranginan pergunungan yang terpencil dan mendapati ia lengang sepenuhnya. Tanpa minyak untuk perjalanan pulang, para pengunjung terpaksa tinggal dan menyiasat misteri di sekitar pondok yang terbengkalai itu.

programme.title: Black S1 EP7
programme.desc: Satu pita rahsia, punca kebimbangan Aisya selama ini berkenaan rahsia masa lalunya yang buruk, telah terbongkar. Betapa gerunnya Aisya apabila menyedari dia menjadi sasaran pembunuh upahan. Sofia bersetuju untuk membantu Black mencari 419 apabila dikatakan kes itu merupakan siasatan tentang ugutan pembunuhan ke atas selebriti kegemaran Sofia, Leo Raja Vokal. Mereka mengesan bunian yang mungkin sedang bersembunyi dalam badan seorang manusia tetapi bunian itu melarikan diri. Black ada sebab yang baik untuk mengawasi Leo kerana bekas pengurusnya merupakan abang ipar 419 yang sudah mati. Black mengesyaki 419 akan membalas dendam terhadap Leo dan apabila itu berlaku, Black bersedia mengheretnya pulang ke dunia bunian. Sementara itu, Borhan meneruskan siasatan ke atas pembunuhan yang berlaku dan menemui masa lalu Seri Setia yang sangat tidak menyenangkan.

programme.title: Bunohan
programme.desc: 3 abang pulang ke kampung Bunohan dengan tiga alasan yang sangat berbeza mereka akan menemui kematian, penipuan dan wahyu yang sangat suram.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP17
programme.desc: Yeh Kumbang berjumpa dengan Nurin, tiba-tiba Aisha pula hilang dari rumah kerana mengikut Wan Peah ke dalam hutan berhampiran. Gani Gagap dan Li Kelubi turut membantu mencarinya tetapi masih gagal. Akhirnya Aisha ditemui ditepi sungai bersama-sama Wan Peah. Farhan dan Cikgu Siti juga keluar mencari Aisha, mereka bersepakat mahu berhadapan dengan Wan Peah kerana mengetahui dia bukan hantu. Cikgu Zaiton membuat fitnah kerana cemburu melihat perhubungan Farhan dengan Cikgu Siti. Akibat tidak berpuas hati, Farhan bersemuka dengan Cikgu Zaiton sehingga berlaku pergaduhan antara mereka.

programme.title: Black S1 EP7
programme.desc: Satu pita rahsia, punca kebimbangan Aisya selama ini berkenaan rahsia masa lalunya yang buruk, telah terbongkar. Betapa gerunnya Aisya apabila menyedari dia menjadi sasaran pembunuh upahan. Sofia bersetuju untuk membantu Black mencari 419 apabila dikatakan kes itu merupakan siasatan tentang ugutan pembunuhan ke atas selebriti kegemaran Sofia, Leo Raja Vokal. Mereka mengesan bunian yang mungkin sedang bersembunyi dalam badan seorang manusia tetapi bunian itu melarikan diri. Black ada sebab yang baik untuk mengawasi Leo kerana bekas pengurusnya merupakan abang ipar 419 yang sudah mati. Black mengesyaki 419 akan membalas dendam terhadap Leo dan apabila itu berlaku, Black bersedia mengheretnya pulang ke dunia bunian. Sementara itu, Borhan meneruskan siasatan ke atas pembunuhan yang berlaku dan menemui masa lalu Seri Setia yang sangat tidak menyenangkan.

programme.title: The Equalizer S2 EP4
programme.desc: McCall semakin hampir ditangkap apabila dia berlumba-lumba untuk menghalang pembunuhan Peguam Daerah Grafton, pendakwa raya yang cuba membawanya ke muka pengadilan.

programme.title: Losmen Melati EP7
programme.desc: Melati, Golok, Sigit dan Ari bersiap sedia untuk melawan Kusno. Sara memasuki losmen mencari Fadil tetapi akhirnya terperangkap di salah satu bilik. Di sana, dia mendapati Fadil terperangkap dalam perigi dari episod 4. Diserang oleh roh rumah, Sara cuba menyelamatkan Fadil dan akhirnya mengorbankan dirinya dalam proses itu. Melati meyakinkan arwah rumah untuk berpihak kepadanya dalam perjuangannya menentang Kusno. Kusno dan Pemburu menyerang Losmen Melati. Sigit berbaik semula dengan Ari atas kengerian masa lalunya dan menentang ayahnya untuk kebaikan. Kini keluar dari perigi, Fadil cuba keluar dari rumah tetapi tersedut untuk melawan Kusno. Berjuang melawan Kusno sendiri, Fadil berada di ambang kematian apabila Kusno menggigitnya, membiarkan kutukan memasuki sistemnya. Apabila semua kelihatan hilang untuk Melati, dia mendedahkan senjata rahsianya - Watih, yang Kusno dipercayai telah mati, kembali untuk memberikan pukulan maut terakhir, akhirnya mengalahkan Kusno sekali dan untuk selama-lamanya. Namun apabila hari baru menjelma, Fadil muncul semula, tetapi semuanya tidak seperti yang disangka. Mata Fadil menjadi hitam, membayangkan kisah Losmen Melati belum berakhir.

programme.title: Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

programme.title: Hani
programme.desc: Hani ialah seorang pelukis manga junior yang kembali ke Malaysia tetapi menghadapi masalah dengan tugasan terbarunya yang berkaitan dengan seorang patung berhantu.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China III
programme.desc: Tuan Wong dan pengikutnya mendaftar dalam Dancing Lion Competition untuk menghentikan plot pembunuhan dan melawan lawan yang sombong dan penipu.

programme.title: Larian Terakhir
programme.desc: Haziq, seorang anak tunggal kepada Mariam yang mempunyai bakat dalam larian pantas, sering berhadapan dengan dugaan kehidupan sehinggakan dia terpaksa meninggalkan ibunya yang sakit. Tanpa disedarinya, pertemuannya dengan Jalal telah memerangkapnya dalam sebuah sindiket jenayah. Walaupun Haziq dijanjikan peluang untuk memperbaiki hidupnya, Amelia sentiasa mengawasi setiap pergerakannya dengan teliti. Larian Terakhir adalah sebuah filem yang menggabungkan genre aksi dan sukan dengan penampilan pelakon-pelakon seperti Fattah Amin, Amyra Rosli, dan Fahrin Ahmad, di mana setiap larian akan sampai ke kemuncaknya.

programme.title: Siku 12: Langkah Derhaka
programme.desc: Seorang bapa telah merahsiakan ilmu persilatan yang telah lama dipelajari daripada anaknya kerana sejarah hitam yang dilaluinya. Anaknya merupakan peninju Muay Thai dan atas desakan yang bertubi-tubi, bapa akhirnya mewariskan ilmu yang dikenali sebagai Jurus Siku 12 Langkah Derhaka kepada anaknya yang akan bertanding pada pertandingan terbuka Pendang Muay Thai 2021.

programme.title: Dabbe Bir Cin Vakasi
programme.desc: Rumah sebuah keluarga di Turki dirasuk roh jahat yang ingin membunuh manusia.

programme.title: Rampok
programme.desc: Seorang wanita bersenjata memasuki sebuah bank untuk merompak. Setelah semua orang dijadikan tebusan, CCTV dimatikan. Pasukan polis yang diketuai oleh Inspektor Natasya tiba untuk berunding dan berhubung dengan perompak. Selepas rundingan berjaya, tiga tebusan dibebaskan. Tanpa disedari oleh pihak polis, salah seorang tebusan yang dibebaskan adalah rakan kepada perompak dan perompak itu sendiri. Para perompak mempunyai kisah silam mereka sendiri yang memaksa mereka melakukan rompakan. Apakah kisah sebenar di sebalik tindakan mereka?

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP1
programme.desc: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP1

programme.title: Bunohan
programme.desc: 3 abang pulang ke kampung Bunohan dengan tiga alasan yang sangat berbeza mereka akan menemui kematian, penipuan dan wahyu yang sangat suram.

programme.title: Black S1 EP8
programme.desc: Lokman mahu mengadakan majlis tari-menari bertopeng untuk mencipta imej positif buat syarikat insuransnya. Memandangkan Leo juga akan hadir, Sofia meyakinkan Black untuk menghadiri majlis tari-menari itu bersamanya, dan ini mendorong Black untuk belajar menari. Tetapi ketika berada di majlis itu, dia ternampak Sofia dan Lokman menari bersama dan timbul rasa cemburu, satu emosi yang asing buat dirinya. Sementara itu, Aisya menerima panggilan misteri daripada telefon Black semasa perjalanannya ke lapangan terbang. Pemanggil misteri itu memberitahu Aisya bahawa nyawa Malik dalam bahaya melainkan dia hadir di majlis tari-menari bertopeng itu. Berjayakah Black menangkap 419 akhirnya atau adakah pembunuh upahan itu dapat menghalang Black dan mengucar-ngacirkan misinya? Kalau Black kehilangan tubuh Malik, dia juga akan kehilangan Sofia, wanita manusia yang telah menyentuh hatinya...

programme.title: The Lift
programme.desc: Selepas sahabat baiknya hilang, seorang gadis kolej yang menghidap klaustrofobia mula menyiasat lif misteri tempat rakannya kali terakhir dilihat lif yang mungkin merupakan pintu ke dunia gelap yang menakutkan.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP18
programme.desc: Ramli dan Mariam menceritakan kepada Cikgu Siti mengenai ibunya Wan Peah. programme.title: Anak Sarawak
programme.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan cool di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.

programme.title: Jiran
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.

programme.title: Usop Wilcha Mehghonjang Makhluk Muzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran Hantu-Hantu Dunia untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
programme.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: Anak Sarawak
programme.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU SIT KA YIN, NANCY met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI KWOK FUNG and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO SHEH CHARMAINE and her adopted child, MAN CHOR CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN. Having been abandoned by her lover, CHORs mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING TONG MICHAEL. CHORs voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HOs future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HOs heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: The Truth Within Whats On Today
programme.desc: Qi Sizhe becomes Director of Forensic Medicine for the Hecheng Criminal Police Unit, reunites with Han Feng, and investigates the truth behind his girlfriend Yu Feis death from the drug Original Diamond three years earlier. Qi Sizhe, Han Feng, and their team uncover Professor Wu Yongchang as the mastermind and Yu Feis true killer. Police raid the drug factory, arrest Wu and the traffickers, and close the new Original Diamond case.

programme.title: Want To De-stress
programme.desc: Many urban dwellers are constantly striving for a living and a career, leaving no time for relaxation. The accumulated stress can quickly trigger health problems. programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show Sr.5
programme.desc: Li Jiading Master Ding, the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up Master Dings Kitchen, partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.title: Cause Of Death
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sums approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun Mark Ma. The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yans buddy Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu Nicholas Yuen evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yans career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-kas death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU SIT KA YIN, NANCY met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI KWOK FUNG and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO SHEH CHARMAINE and her adopted child, MAN CHOR CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN. Having been abandoned by her lover, CHORs mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING TONG MICHAEL. CHORs voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HOs future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HOs heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestantsHo Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-szeset aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various outdoor experts on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong wild women with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.title: News At 18:30 Global View Whats On Today
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Cause Of Death
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sums approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun Mark Ma. The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yans buddy Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu Nicholas Yuen evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yans career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-kas death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!

programme.title: The Truth Within
programme.desc: Qi Sizhe becomes Director of Forensic Medicine for the Hecheng Criminal Police Unit, reunites with Han Feng, and investigates the truth behind his girlfriend Yu Feis death from the drug Original Diamond three years earlier. A series of nightclub attacks, cocoon murders, medical-school specimen crimes, insurance frauds, and silencing killings all point to a new narcotic and a drug-manufacturing ring. Qi Sizhe, Han Feng, and their team uncover Professor Wu Yongchang as the mastermind and Yu Feis true killer. Police raid the drug factory, arrest Wu and the traffickers, and close the new Original Diamond case.

programme.title: Cho Lam His Trip Buddies
programme.desc: After his One-Stroke-Wear journey to Dongguan and Shantou, Wong Cho-lam continues his series authentic style with another travel program. This time, however, hell be joined by friends, and the main theme will be a series of in-depth revisites along the milestones in Cho-lams life, uncovering the fun and warmth of everyday life. The filming locations span Fuzhou, Guangxi, and Vancouverthree distinctive places that have held significant meaning for Cho-lam at different stages of his life. Cho-lam walks through the streets and alleys with three groups of travel friends, exploring everything from hometown connections and cultural awakening to the most important aspecthis romantic destinytelling his unique story through travel snippets.

programme.title: EXTRA
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. We report on the newest developments of artists, promotions for TV series and movies, highlights from concerts, and coverage of grand award ceremonies. We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audienceensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment.

programme.title: Limbo
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of brutal murders committed by a serial killer. Veteran detective Cham and rookie cop Will are assigned to the case. During the investigation, they encounter Wang Tao, who accidentally killed Chams wife. Seeking redemption, Wang assists them in tracking down the killer, but her involvement puts her in grave danger.

programme.title: Its A Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Hong Kong tycoon Ren Da Kuan takes care of his family that spans four generations, yet his three sons grapple with their own challenges. Everything changes when his daughter returns from studying in France with her friend Roberto. Roberto brings a wave of transformation to the Ren family, sparking new hope and opportunities for all.

programme.title: Marriage With A Liar
programme.desc: Kiki and her boyfriend of seven years, Sean, are to be married in a week but both cheated on each other three days before the wedding. Faced with each of their perfect partners, Kiki and Sean ignore their responsibilities to each other and choose to go their separate ways

programme.title: A Legend
programme.desc: Archaeologist Professor Fang uncovers artifacts from a glacier expedition that resembles a jade pendant in his dream. To unveil the truth, Professor Fang leads his team to a journey into the glacier, embarking on a fantastical adventure together.

programme.title: Hit N Fun
programme.desc: Former Muay Thai legend Zhong Lei trains pro fighters despite his gyms struggles. When ad executive Lin learns her boyfriend is cheating with a champion boxer, she challenges her rival to a match and undergoes brutal training under Zhong. Through the grueling process, Lins quest for revenge transforms into a journey of self-discovery.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Come Back Home
programme.desc: In a chilly winter, De and his family goes on a self-drive tour to Changbai Mountain. The holiday turns tragic when Des eight-year-old son goes missing. He seeks help from the local police but is unable to find his son. Though the golden hour has passed, De and the rescue team insist on continuing the search. Can they finally rescue the boy?

programme.title: The White Storm 3 Heaven Or Hell
programme.desc: Hong Kong cop Billy works undercover in Suchats drug cartel, while another undercover cop Wing successfully earns their trust in an incident and a brotherly bond is built among the three. When the police busts the syndicate, Suchat flees to the Golden Triangle with Billy and receives a tip-off about the betrayal within his circle of trust

programme.title: Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: A Chinese dessert shop owned by the Chang family in Kowloon City faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. Their daughter sacrifices her dream of becoming a flight attendant to help keep the family business alive, but tensions rise as she clashes with her father. Can they find a way to overcome their struggles and remain united?

programme.title: Ip Man 3
programme.desc: When some gangsters led by a ruthless American property developer force a school to sell their land, Ip Man fights to protect it. Subsequently, Ip Man is challenged by another Wing Chun master Zhang Tian Zhi for the Grandmaster title. Ip Man accepts the challenge for the sake of his family and disciples, and wins the duel for the title.

programme.title: The Movie Emperor
programme.desc: Hong Kong megastar Lau Wai Chi aspires to win a film award. He teams up with director Lin Hao to make a film about rural China so as to win at the international film festival, and experiences local village life for the farmers role. This ends up in a series of hilarious events instead.

programme.title: Dont Forget I Love You
programme.desc: Lu Yao suffers from amnesia and forgets about everything that happens yesterday when he wakes up the next day. When Lu Yao meets psychotherapist Xing Yue, they fall in love despite knowing they have no future together, and are determined to love each other no matter what happens...

programme.title: Back to the Past
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lives in seclusion for 20 years. However, peace is shattered when a group of time travellers returns with modern weapons to seize the Qin throne. Forced to reunite after decades apart, Hong Siu Lung and Ying Zheng must fight to defend the Qin dynasty and protect the fate of history itself.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Amid the recession caused by the pandemic, debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. His unconventional approach leads to unexpected success, and his attitude toward his career and life is transformed after being inspired by the respected Master Wen.

programme.title: P Storm
programme.desc: Ping reports a case of a rich mans son bribing prison guards to cover up his criminal activities in the prison to the ICAC. ICAC Chief Officer Luk goes undercover in prison to conduct his investigation. Despite the risks involved, Luk is determined to complete his mission with the help of his cell mate, Wang.

programme.title: To Live and Die in Mongkok
programme.desc: Fai Nick Cheung, a legendary triad figure, was convicted and sent to prison for slaughtering a bunch of people. 30 years later, with the help of a social worker Chan Lai Wan, Fai release from prison, the city of Mongkok has totally changed and he has almost forgotten his way back home. Disoriented and trapped in the notorious town of vices, Fai must find his way out of a life with a mother suffering from Alzheimers disease Paw Hee Ching, a hooker girlfriend Mo Xiaoqi with her mentally-challenged younger sister Natalie Meng, and a malicious cop Liu Kai Chi hot on his tail.

programme.title: Mr Mrs Incredible
programme.desc: Middle-aged and retired superhero couple, Huan Gazer Man and Red Aroma Woman, settles into a contented life in a remote village. They find it hard to contain their powers though, and are bored by the uneventful life. When they hear a world martial arts contest is to be held in their village, both are itching to make their long-awaited comeback!

programme.title: Peg O My Heart
programme.desc: Psychiatrist Dr. Man begins treating night-shift taxi driver Choi, who is afraid to sleep and can no longer distinguish dreams from reality. During therapy, Dr. Man becomes haunted by his own disturbing and perplexing dreams. Are these night terrors the result of repressed memories, or the price of uncovering the ghosts hidden in Chois past?

programme.title: No One Like Me
programme.desc: Yang Qian Huan, the third disciple of the Imperial Astronomer, was once a golden boy. However, since the birth of Xu Qi An, his glory has waned. His relentless pursuit cannot defy a merciless truth: all has been foretold. Yet rising from his downfall, Yang defiantly forges his own path, refusing to bow to fate.

programme.title: Smashing Frank
programme.desc: Four young thieves wearing bunny masks pull off the heists targeting the rich. Calling themselves Frank, their mission is less about money and more about exposing corruption through graffiti and viral videos. However, when they collide with a powerful church involved in a money-laundering scheme, their mission spirals into a deadly game.

programme.title: Alls Well Ends Well 2009
programme.desc: Successful businesswoman Yu Chu has no chance of finding a husband with her insufferable personality, much to the consternation of her younger brother Yu Bo, who due to a curse, will fail in love until his sister gets married. Yu Bo hires a love expert, Dick, to woo his sister. Smitten at first sight, Yu Chu is not about to let Dick get away...

programme.title: Oversteer
programme.desc: Adapted from a true story, the film follows Feng, a determined young man who defies his father to pursue his dream of becoming an automotive mechanic. Alongside his childhood friend Yun, he embarks on a daring journey that unexpectedly plunges them into the exhilarating world of racing, sparking a passionate coming-of-age adventure.

programme.title: My First of May
programme.desc: Former squash champion Teng and his wife face devastating trials when their daughter is diagnosed with muscular dystrophy and his mother with cancer. Years later, as the family struggles between holding on and letting go, they find a new connection through a small but powerful sign of hope: the faint movement of their daughters pinky finger.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival.

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: The five Kao brothers, separated since birth, are unaware that the master of Teng Lung Manor has killed their father. All five however, vow to defeat the vicious gangsters at the manor due to their bullying ways. After reuniting and with much discipline and hard work, the Kaos are prepared to face Lung and his gang.

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: Diary Of A Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fans fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a trap set by the White Bone Demon sisters, and Wukong must use his powers to save his master.

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: The second film of the trilogy, Gordon Liu plays Zhou Ren Jie, a man who impersonates a monk in order to learn kung fu in Shaolin, and eventually creates his own Shaolin style of scaffolding kung fu.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: An elite fortune hunter and a reckless young heir team up to search for a legendary pirate treasure. Their quest leads them to a remote monastery, where they must outwit a formidable Shaolin monk. However, when ruthless bandits close in, the unlikely allies must put aside their differences and fight side by side to survive.

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keepers daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with The Five Venoms actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarre weapons in his films. The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bits created by these five dudes. You have the good guys from the righteous clan versus the bad guys from the villainous clan and its so filled with dont-blink-or-you-will-miss-something gags, you will need to watch it over and over again so you can see the things you missed.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer Li Ching, the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the sick people of Asia and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock n roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: A professors assistant stole a micro-film storing the secret of a newly invented nuclear reactor and sells it to a crime syndicate. However, the micro-film accidentally falls into the hands of a nightclub dancer and a thief in the process, leading to them being relentlessly pursued by the crime syndicate to retrieve the micro-film.

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Si Si, a spoiled and naive rich girl with only basic kung fu training, becomes enchanted by the legends of the fearless hero Qin Ge. Determined to escape her fathers arranged marriage, she disguises herself as a man and sets out to find him, hoping to challenge Qin Geonly to be drawn into a deadly plot within the criminal underworld.

programme.title: The Golden Lion
programme.desc: The Golden Lion is a bandit with good martial arts skills and often robs from the rich to help the poor. He is ambushed and attacked by a gang one night but luckily finds help from a master healer, who has to find a way to treat him while they are both being chased by the gang.

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: Jiang Xiao Yu is separated from his twin brother as a baby after his parents are murdered. He is taken by a couple to Villains Valley and raised to be a villain by a host of outlaws. Jiang leaves the valley to explore the world when he grows up. Will he be able to avenge his parents and meet with his twin brother?

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s a-go-go era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters
programme.desc: Young Wong Fei Hung must prove himself worthy to be taught by Master Lu, who was also his fathers martial arts teacher. Although he is defeated in a competition, Wong Fei Hungs passion in Kung Fu finally moves Lu and allows him to become Lus disciple.

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: Yun Fei Yang, a Wudang servant hiding his identity as the sect leaders illegitimate son, is framed by long-hidden enemies and branded a traitor after losing his father. Hunted by rival forces and stripped of his martial arts, he masters the legendary Tian Chan Gong and rises again to clear his name and settle a generations-old blood feud.

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Accepted to the Golden Sword School after his father sacrificed his life to save his master, Fang Kang is resented by his fellow pupils and decides to leave. His masters daughter challenges him to a fight and cuts off his arm. Fang masters the art of sword fighting with one arm and finds himself returning to the School to save his master again.

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriends baby...

programme.title: Lady Of The Law
programme.desc: Chan, the chief of Wan Sheng Escort, is forced to raise his opponents son, Yim. While Chan forbids Yim to practice martial arts, Yim secretly learns it. Ten years later, a rapist appears and Yim is arrested by a lady constable as the suspect. The rapist turns out to be Chans elder son and Yim is framed by the Chans. Can Yim prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hongs enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends.

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular Venom Lo Meng.

programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: A young woman buys a vintage car that behaves oddly, only to discover its possessed by a vengeful spirit connected to her past.

programme.title: Vadacurry
programme.desc: Sathish, who is ashamed of his cheap phone, gives in to temptation when he finds one lying unattended in a shop and steals it. Unfortunately for him, the phone belongs to someone dangerous.

programme.title: En Aaloda Seruppa Kaanom
programme.desc: Sandhya is distraught when she loses her slippers which were a gift from her father, but Krishnan promises to find them. Meanwhile, her father gets kidnapped in Syria.

programme.title: Sarkarin Elam
programme.desc: A finance agent is conned by his love interest and travels to India to get his money back from her influential father, who is a Member of Parliament and industrialist.

programme.title: Ivan Kavalkaran
programme.desc: Vijay, an honest police officer, meets Samyukta at a cafe and falls in love with her. However, his life changes when he witnesses a kidnapping and ends up helping a lonely woman, Lavanya.

programme.title: KGF: Chapter 2
programme.desc: Rocky successfully rises as the leader and saviour of the people of the Kolar Gold Fields. But, in his goal to fulfil his mothers wishes, Rocky must tackle Adheera, Inayat Khalil and Ramika Sen.

programme.title: Ka Pae Ranasingam
programme.desc: Ariyanachi, a poor woman, strives to bring her deceased husbands body back to India from Dubai, battling the odds of political agenda, corruption and a treacherous bureaucracy that stand in her way.

programme.title: Oru Pakka Kathai
programme.desc: Meera and Saravanan fall in love with each other and decide to get married after completing their education. However, their lives turn upside down when she gets pregnant while still being a virgin.

programme.title: Mr Mrs Arjun
programme.desc: Arjun, a spoiled young man, grows jealous of his neighbor Anus admiration and discovers her plans to study abroad, plotting to sabotage her dreams and ruin her chance at a brighter future.

programme.title: Kishkindapuri
programme.desc: During a ghost tour, visitors enter a radio station and awaken a dormant spirit. Trapped inside, they must find a way out as supernatural forces threaten them.

programme.title: Ravanasura
programme.desc: Junior lawyer, Ravindra, agrees to help a business magnate clear her fathers name of murder, but his true colors are revealed as more bodies appear.

programme.desc: A powerful tycoon controls a helpless village-until a bold jockey arrives. With grit and heart, he races not just horses, but injustice, bringing hope and courage to the people.

programme.title: Uppu Karuvaadu
programme.desc: Chandran, a filmmaker, is forced to cast the producers daughter, Mahalakshmi, as the heroine in his movie. But Mahalakshmi cannot act and Chandran struggles to teach her how to act.

programme.title: Chill Bro
programme.desc: Whoa, major bummer! Sis accidentally offed her bro. Now shes lost in flashbacks, dealing with surprise guests, until the cops finally show up. Talk about awkward!

programme.title: Oh My Kadavule
programme.desc: Two friends, Anu and Arjun, marry, but misunderstandings complicate their life, leading to a divorce.

programme.title: Bhaagamathie
programme.desc: Chanchala Reddy, an IAS officer, is imprisoned in a haunted house for interrogation. However, things take an unexpected turn when she gets possessed by a spirit.

programme.title: Idhu Kadhirvelan Kadhal
programme.desc: Kathir hates the idea of marriage, but when he falls for his sweet neighbor Pavithra, everything changes. Love blossoms. until heartbreak strikes, teaching him about love and loss.

programme.title: Endrendrum Punnagai
programme.desc: Goutham grows up hating women after his mother abandons him during his childhood. Though he decides to stay single while his friends marry, Priya changes his mind about singlehood.

programme.title: Nanban Oruvan Vantha Piragu
programme.desc: Anand, in the travel back to his home to reunite with his friends , looks back at his life in 8 chapters, trying to find an answer to the question of Whats happiness Am I happy?

programme.title: Kalavani Mappillai
programme.desc: Deva, eager to marry the love of his life, tries to hide his inability to drive from his future mother-in-law. His efforts lead to hilarious situations as he tries to keep the secret.

programme.title: Love Story
programme.desc: A Christian Zumba instructor falls in love with a starry-eyed upper caste Hindu girl. In their quest for happiness, however, they must first overcome a massive caste divide.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand
programme.desc: New Zealands West Coast is like nowhere else on Earth. From glacier-covered mountains to rain-drenched native forests to rough frigid seas, the landscape defies belief. Isolated from the rest of the world, this strip of almost untouched wilderness hides a host of endemic animals. Evolutionary castaways, every one of them is a rare ecological jewel. From alpine parrots and shy penguins to mammal-like kiwis and ancient eels. To survive the conditions the wildlife here has to be hardy, cunning and resourceful. A journey along the West Coast reveals the beauty of this land, and the trials and tribulations of the wildlife that live here.

programme.title: 生活智多星
programme.desc: 人間衛視生活智多星邀請到好門媳婦－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上智多星本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解生活智多星內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射充滿元氣的不老傳說以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，生活智多星全面關心

programme.desc: 節目邀請到大家熟悉的萬人美老師－郭昱晴擔任主持人以系列為節目核心，邀請在相同體系內，受到推崇的精英人士，分享其堅守追求專業的精神與受挫不懈的毅力並且將依照不同專業，結合生活觀點，推出相符的小單元內容兼具權威與風趣，不僅拉近觀眾與來賓距離，也從中看到來賓不為人知的另一面如節目中熱血仁醫系列，除了分享醫生在白色巨塔中奮鬥的故事之外，也會依其專業，在預防醫學的概念下，加入醫療科技新資訊及獨門養生撇步等小單元

programme.title: 梵音清流
programme.desc: 此音只應天上有，人間哪得幾回聞梵唄就是清淨之意，除了耳根享受之外，最主要的仍在心靈的清淨，歌詠時還伴以管弦或敲擊樂器，普及佛教教義

programme.title: 好好玩自然
programme.desc: 想成為生態達人嗎？喜愛悠遊山海叢林與動物昆蟲親近的小朋友別錯過囉！就讓柳丁哥哥與生態專家阿峰，帶你探索台灣豐富的自然生態， 與各種動物做朋友，一起揭開大自然的神秘面紗！

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流人間新聞此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任人間新聞報導的焦點包含慈善公益社會關懷文化藝術人文教育心靈提升健康醫療環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌

programme.title: 生活智多星
programme.desc: 人間衛視生活智多星邀請到好門媳婦－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上智多星本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解生活智多星內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射充滿元氣的不老傳說以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，生活智多星全面關心

programme.title: 幸福食堂
programme.desc: 由人氣主持人攜手多位蔬食名廚，現場烹調精緻美味的蔬食餐點，讓您大飽眼福，也大飽口福

programme.title: 藝次元宇宙

programme.title: 手術直播間
programme.desc: 講述天才醫生鄭仁為查多年前的冤案來到海城醫院，與急診科主任蘇雲組成搭檔在一次次搶救生死的過程中，他們不僅面對醫學挑戰，也揭開醫院內部隱藏的黑暗秘密，逐步逼近當年的真相鄭仁用專業治癒病患，蘇雲則以溫暖守護患者與團隊，兩人共同成長彼此信任，實現醫者初心，也在人性與職業的考驗中，找到生命的意義與愛的力量

programme.title: 辣妹釘孤支第1集
programme.desc: 處於人生低潮的杜力香，感情事業連遭背叛 ，臨時被媽媽一通電話拐回東港老家 ，卻為面子謊稱自己是，國際知名瑪莎葛蘭姆舞團的舞者 堅持走高尚路線的筱芸霞團主杜秋元 ，不得不面對觀眾日漸流失的窘境 ，在師弟三點言語刺激下，竟定下三場拼台之約，輸的人必須永遠離開東港代父出征的顏光大，被迫放棄自己的音樂生涯，走上從政之路始料未及，而父親繁榮東港的夢想是光大最沈重的負擔楊老師孜孜念念的藝霞歌舞劇團，那曾經光榮的一頁，能否在籌備回顧展的過程中，解開力香與秋元父女倆多年的心結拼台的時間一天天接近，霓虹燈下，決定筱芸霞存亡的華麗舞台上，冷冰冰的鋼管能否串起所有失落的心魂，於人生的戰鬥中

programme.desc: 一樣的月光是1983年蘇芮首張個人專輯的主打歌，也是1983年台灣電影搭錯車的插曲1983年，新藝城的導演虞戡平策畫一部結合音樂與戲劇的電影搭錯車；這部電影描繪了7080年代台灣經濟高速成長，阿美一心想進入的歌舞影壇的故事此張專輯成功將電影主角的故事與音樂結合，是台灣首度以音樂影片（MV）的方式製作專輯當時虞戡平仍在尋找主角的幕後主唱，在電視上聽到蘇芮演唱西洋歌曲，音色相當不錯，便屬意她來擔任主唱專輯由李壽全製作，並找來羅大佑梁弘志等人寫曲一樣的月光歌詞承襲了羅大佑的風格，對社會現象的改變做出批判與反省，蘇芮獨特的嗓音也造就了黑色蘇芮的旋風是中文流行音樂史上

programme.title: 大自然生趣第21集
programme.desc: 你知道台灣原生的鹿科動物總共有幾種嗎？你知道留鳥與夏候鳥的差別嗎？你知道南路鷹一萬死九千這句話的由來嗎？你知道有哪些鳥是父親負責孵蛋跟照顧小孩呢？ 請共下來瞭解，大自然生趣 大自然生趣，照字面意思來說，是自然界中生生不息的各種生物所帶來的許多趣味很湊巧的，生趣這兩個字，其實這是客語有趣的發音，因此換成客語來說，就是大自然真有趣這個節目是將客籍生態紀錄片導演劉燕明先生三十餘年來上山下海，辛苦拍攝所得的豐富生態影像，以每集5分鐘之短篇製作成有趣又具生態教育意義的短片，具有兩大特色：1.生態專業團隊製作：導演劉燕明先生與撰稿旁白的鄧慶煜先生，兩人皆具備生態與紀錄片拍

programme.title: 大自然生趣第22集
programme.desc: 你知道台灣原生的鹿科動物總共有幾種嗎？你知道留鳥與夏候鳥的差別嗎？你知道南路鷹一萬死九千這句話的由來嗎？你知道有哪些鳥是父親負責孵蛋跟照顧小孩呢？ 請共下來瞭解，大自然生趣 大自然生趣，照字面意思來說，是自然界中生生不息的各種生物所帶來的許多趣味很湊巧的，生趣這兩個字，其實這是客語有趣的發音，因此換成客語來說，就是大自然真有趣這個節目是將客籍生態紀錄片導演劉燕明先生三十餘年來上山下海，辛苦拍攝所得的豐富生態影像，以每集5分鐘之短篇製作成有趣又具生態教育意義的短片，具有兩大特色：1.生態專業團隊製作：導演劉燕明先生與撰稿旁白的鄧慶煜先生，兩人皆具備生態與紀錄片拍

programme.desc: 要擁有福氣人生，可以透過聆聽牧師們以台語分享聖經的真理，讓你領受天國滿滿的福氣與祝福這些牧師們將以深入淺出的方式解釋聖經，將其應用於當代生活，讓你明白神的心意和計劃通過聆聽台語講道，你可以更深入地理解聖經的教導，並在日常生活中實踐這些講道將提供實際的指引和智慧，幫助你在家庭工作人際關係等各個領域經歷神的福氣聆聽這樣的講道，你將能夠領悟到屬天的價值觀和生活方式，學習依靠聖靈的帶領，活出基督徒的身份和見證這將使你能夠更深入地體驗神的愛和恩典，並將其傳遞給他人

programme.title: 健康新煮流系列第204集
programme.desc: 探索產業風情，通過讓KC走出去並進行優等食材大搜查的方式來介紹我們將結合休閒農漁牧產業以及各地的產銷班，展示各種加值特產品在輕鬆活潑的氛圍中，我們將向觀眾介紹農村養殖漁業和畜牧業的各種風情 主持人Claire是客家子弟，而Kevin則來自新加坡他們將從多元的觀點出發，呈現台灣飲食文化的融合，包括閩南客家外省

programme.title: 共享觀點第197集
programme.desc: 共享觀點期待用分享而非說教的方式和年輕人談論聖經的觀點和真理透過主持人周巽正牧師和廖文華牧師輕鬆幽默的對談，並結合網路社群媒體，分享他們的信仰與生活的經驗，傳達聖經真理價值觀

programme.title: 機智青年生活第12集

programme.title: 遇見祝福第8集
programme.desc: 福音短片，每天三分鐘，能夠重新激發您的力量並蒙受祝福！這些短片以生活化的例證，幫助朋友們更深入地認識耶穌！讓您在忙碌的生活中，用短短三分鐘，與福音相連，並與耶穌建立更親密的關係！

programme.title: 真情部落格第815集
programme.desc: 自2005年開播以來，真情部落格已訪問數百位生命勇士當這些勇士面對生命中的困難時，他們選擇依靠對耶穌的信心，勇敢地克服挑戰這些可愛的基督徒願意與大家分享他們生命中最黑暗最脆弱的一面，目的是將來自天上的美好福分帶給人們每一個充滿血淚的生命見證都是令人震撼的轉變，帶來最深刻的真實感

programme.title: 全球動物冒險王第7季:第3集

programme.title: 全球動物冒險王第7季:第4集

programme.title: 工程大改造第5集

programme.title: 印度的老虎傳奇

programme.title: 終極苦旅第4季:第2集

programme.title: 古文明帝國崛起第5集

programme.title: 飛機追追追第2季:第8集
programme.desc: 本集凱文雷西與麥克甘迺迪這兩位一向王不見王的頂尖討債專家要聯手出擊，進行史上規模最浩大的收回案兩人再加上海瑟將潛入北威斯康辛州的一座私人頂級高空跳傘訓練設施，一次偷取三架德哈威蘭雙獺飛機麥克與另一名飛行員將穿著飛鼠裝滑翔到附近的空地，確認場地安全後引導凱文著陸，再徒步潛入設施內，卻發現其中一架的引擎被拆解維修凱文雖然儘快修復，仍由於時間耽擱而使任務蒙上風險，迫使海瑟不得不再次挺身而出施展調虎離山之計另一方面，肯與丹尼也準備進行自己的一箭三雕任務，到密西根湖尋找速度超快的海士樂賽艇以及拖運用的卡車與拖車幾經波折，兩人仍靠著天衣無縫的合作，成功完成了任務

programme.title: 舊貨獵人第20季:第5集
programme.desc: 德魯普里察與薇琪諾特一同踏上旅程，拜會英國最厲害的收藏達人

programme.title: 倉儲挖寶王第4季:第13集
programme.desc: 由於最近當鋪店的生意不太好，尤其是古董類的商品滯銷，因此湯提議應該進一點新貨，找些刀械槍枝等物品這次到了拍賣現場，艾倫和湯又遇到了宿敵凱若琳，而且被她擺了一道，心裡很不是滋味但是除了面對宿敵以外，艾倫和湯也起了內鬨，兩人對於是否競標倉庫意見相左，爭執不下艾倫執意要買第一間倉庫，但是湯阻止了他，讓艾倫覺得錯失了大好機會；湯想買下第二間倉庫，雖然艾倫極力勸阻，但湯卻花了4千元買下，這使得兩人的嫌隙變得更大，終至難以彌補

programme.title: 倉儲挖寶王第4季:第14集
programme.desc: 自從湯和艾倫上次大吵一架後，湯就決定暫時離開當鋪去度假他的度假方式就是前往好朋友開的汽車改造店，自己動手把他的卡車重新改造一番；湯非常享受這種自己動手改裝的過程，也想念起這種生活，並開始思考是否應該放棄倉儲拍賣生意另一方面，由於湯帶走了許多存貨，使得當鋪的生意一落千丈艾倫必須再去拍賣場補貨，她只好帶著新手艾兒同行不料他們與凱若琳狹路相逢，艾兒和凱若琳在拍賣會上針鋒相對，誰也不肯退讓同時艾倫對於湯的一走了之仍然耿耿於懷

programme.title: 追謎探險隊第10季:第11集
programme.desc: 為了慶祝最愛的電影七寶奇謀上映四十週年，喬許要勇闖奧勒岡海岸，尋找啟發這部電影的海盜寶藏遺跡

programme.title: 層層透視古文明第5季:第20集
programme.desc: 本集節目帶領觀眾認識元上都這座由成吉思汗之孫忽必烈創立的都城具有濃厚傳奇色彩，馬可波羅的遊記中提及了元上都，描述這座古都無比壯觀華麗，遺址中出土的遺物也顯示此地曾經十分繁榮，而且居民多元化，包容各種文化與信仰但是如今曾經輝煌的元上都只剩下任由風吹雨打的斷垣殘壁，究竟發生了什麼事？敬請鎖定本節目

programme.title: 絕地伐木勇士第2季:第16集
programme.desc: 自古以來，伐木一直是人類生活的重要產業，時至今日，仍是世界上最危險的工作之一樹越大，風險越高...報酬也越可觀在太平洋西北地區，伐木工傑瑞德道格拉斯帶著團隊，採伐世界上最巨大最有價值的樹種之一：北美檜木但要把這些體積跟巴士一樣大的巨木，從森林運送到市場一點也不容易不僅需要高超的鋸木功夫規模龐大的機械設備，還要有在地表最嚴酷環境上工的勇氣

programme.title: 我的男友是媽寶第4季:第3集

programme.title: 動物百分百第3季:第8集
programme.desc: 甲殼類是數量龐大的一群生物，至少有5萬個物種，屬於節肢動物門

programme.title: 鱷魚拍檔這一家第2季:第8集
programme.desc: 澳洲動物園的救援隊接到民眾電話，有一隻針鼴躲進一間蔬果行的冰箱下，請他們去幫忙白天店內來來往往的顧客讓夜行性的針鼴沒有安全感蜷縮在角落不肯出來，無計可施下，羅伯特一行三人只好在水果店晚上打烊後再來，輕鬆帶走針鼴並野放賓蒂參與一項鯨鯊研究，協助拍攝鯨鯊鰓後的身分識別圖案，供研究人員追蹤研究鯨鯊習性賓蒂想起喜愛與鯨鯊同游的父親史帝夫，於是將這隻鯨鯊命名為史帝夫泰瑞回到家鄉俄勒岡州拜訪野生動物復健機野生動物印象，協助檢查棕熊寇弟的口腔寇弟最近經常流口水，檢查後，拔除一顆碎裂的臼齒，控制住感染源，預計寇弟很快能恢復健康和體力

programme.title: 管教惡貓第4季:第12集
programme.desc: 麥斯是安娜的愛貓安娜剛養麥斯時，牠還是隻溫馴的小貓但麥斯的個性愈來愈兇暴，連安娜的兒子克里斯來訪時，麥斯也會攻擊牠安娜和克里斯都是義大利人克里斯小時候最美好的回憶就是在祖母家玩但因為麥斯很愛攻擊人，克里斯不敢帶妻兒回家，安娜也無法享受義大利人最珍惜的天倫之樂傑克森後來發現麥斯的攻擊性是來自不安全感在他的協助下，麥斯和克里斯終於學會互相信任麥斯變成一隻溫馴的貓，安娜和她的孫子也終於能聚在一起共進晚餐了

programme.title: 野地刺客第3集
programme.desc: 從北極凍原到熱帶海洋，都有擅長匿蹤隱形的野地刺客透過偽裝或是藏身在環境裡，這些自然界的殺手常常突然冒出來，撲向毫無戒心的獵物

programme.title: 自然怪事求解答第1季:第18集

programme.title: 熱血獸醫師第3季:第2集
programme.desc: 本集熱血獸醫師傑夫替12歲的母狗法克西動緊急手術切除唾腺，因為牠抓破了腮幫子，唾液造成傷狗感染蓄膿貓咪克拉莫先生不慎摔傷，髖關節脫臼，成為第一位唐主刀的病患尼可艾咪和海克特的外診團隊到洛磯山脈山麓的威靈頓，替一處牧場裡的兩隻迷你驢施行閹割手術白兔雪兒的耳朵有跳蚤，身上被馬蠅幼蟲寄生，拜爾醫生替牠解除了這些麻煩

programme.title: 野地的貓科第3集
programme.desc: 亞洲是世界上最大的大陸，全球超過一半的人口住在這裡，這裡的野地貓科動物受到人類活動的影響，棲地遭到破壞劣化而變得破碎，亟需保護

programme.title: 百變水族箱來幫忙
programme.desc: 這集百變水族箱特輯跟拍瓶裝海洋的工作人員葛瑞20年前是證券經紀人，但他始終熱愛水族世界，因此展開自己的水族箱事業瓶裝海洋有幾位重量級的客戶，包括奧蘭多國際機場和蓋洛帕母斯度假會議中心本案是幫EG伏特加公司打造吧台水族箱，水族箱長3公尺，寬0.9公尺，前面為圓弧造型，為了讓水族箱跟吧台等高，過濾系統將置於水族箱後方水族箱內塑造逼真的太平洋西北地區森林，象徵EG伏特加的水源，最後在背景安裝電視

programme.title: 管教惡貓第4季:第13集
programme.desc: 室友赫多跟瑞克的貓佛陀很凶猛，會攻擊他們跟客人，他們的關係也受到影響赫多的房間禁止佛陀禁入，但情況並沒有因此改善，問題再不解決，赫多可能就要搬家了；李察跟黛安結婚四年，並領養了狄倫，他們還有一隻大狗奇可除了貓狗無法同處一室，狄倫在他們晚上睡覺時也會不斷騷擾，夫妻倆無法一覺到天亮已經好幾年，婚姻也因此亮起紅燈，傑克森必須想辦法讓貓狗能夠共處才能挽救這段婚姻

programme.title: 鱷魚拍檔這一家第2季:第9集
programme.desc: 澳洲動物園有兩隻斑馬較老的是二十四歲的斑馬贊比西，比較年經的是盧卡斯贊比西和盧卡斯是形影不離的好朋友，這是因為斑馬是群居動物，必須和同伴在一起非洲草原的食草動物都過著群居生活，牠們會互相警戒如果有大型掠食動物出現，某隻斑馬一發現掠食動物，整群斑馬就會立刻逃走因此澳洲動物園的斑馬也很重視友誼但對斑馬而言，二十四歲已經是古稀之年贊比西的牙齒已經磨損得很嚴重，無法順利地吃草因此獸醫只能為牠進行安樂死動物園也找來一隻新斑馬和盧卡斯作伴

programme.desc: 寶貝星樂園，歡樂總動員！MOMO親子台特地開闢一個園地，讓2-12歲的小朋友可以在寶貝星樂園展現他們的才藝，秀出他們的熱情大方可以看到唱歌舞蹈樂器演奏等等不同小朋友的才藝，還有小朋友表演時自信投入的表現，以及家長們陪同練習在旁加油的溫馨畫面等等，節目氣氛歡樂又熱鬧！除了 邀請專業的評審老師給予建議講評之外，每集也會選出最佳造型獎最佳人氣獎以及閃亮小明星獎給予鼓勵，也能為小朋友們留下一個快樂的童年回憶，歡迎2 -12歲的小朋友們踴躍報名參加！

programme.title: 紙箱做玩具
programme.desc: 最好玩的DIY節目，趕快跟著哥哥姐姐一起來動手做玩具！ 家中一定都有不需要的紙箱，就把這些紙箱變成桌上型的迷你玩具吧！有：投籃機扭蛋機掌上型遊戲機好玩的對戰遊戲等，親子一起動手做全家人一起玩遊戲真是太有趣了

programme.title: 霸王龍雷奇
programme.desc: 這是一個關於親情友情勇氣和愛的故事很久很久以前，有一隻特別的霸王龍，他叫雷奇在尚未孵化的時候，雷奇就被一隻雌性慈母龍撿回家，成為食草恐龍家庭的一員身為食肉恐龍的他，有捕食者的本能，但媽媽的細心教導讓他明白，不能傷害他人，所以他努力克制，成為了一隻外表兇猛，但心地善良的霸王龍在與家人朋友鄰居們的相處中，雷奇和他的性格各異的恐龍小夥伴們相互理解相互陪伴，體會到了親情友情的溫暖，學會了勇敢和愛，一起快樂生活，慢慢長大

programme.title: 泡泡孔雀魚

programme.title: 瑪莎與熊
programme.desc: 瑪莎是個充滿朝氣活力四射的小女孩，住在離森林不遠的小木屋裡有天意外地闖進住在森林的熊熊家，開始了充滿歡笑與奇妙的生活從馬戲團退休的熊熊，在森林裡度過了安穩平淡的退休生活，直到遇到了瑪莎，為他的生活增添了許多樂趣，從一開始害怕瑪莎的調皮搗蛋，到逐漸他們成為了最棒的朋友在他們的生活裡充滿著瑪莎的好奇心與熊熊對瑪莎悉心的教導與照顧 瑪莎與熊來自於俄羅斯的3D動畫，故事內容源自於俄羅斯的童話，在俄羅斯受到了大朋友與小朋友的歡迎，故事搬到現代的大螢幕中，更增添了許多冒險故事動畫中所呈現的音樂與內容都有著濃濃的俄羅斯風情，並透過立體3D的呈現方式帶來了視覺與聽覺上的饗宴 瑪莎與熊以輕

programme.desc: 以寶可夢大師為目標繼續旅行的主角小智和搭檔皮卡丘來到了新的冒險舞台神奧地區隨後，他們與目標成為頂級協調訓練家的小光和她的波加曼邂逅，一同踏上旅程各種各樣的邂逅，了解同伴的重要，在戰鬥中洋溢熾熱的友情，不斷成長

programme.title: 魔法咪路咪路第14集
programme.desc: 剛升上國中二年級的小楓，一直盼望能與仰慕已久的結木攝兩情相悅某日小楓買了一個可以實現愛情願望的馬克杯，召喚出小精靈咪路，但是個性彆扭的咪路不肯為小楓施展魔法，雖然小楓極力想討好咪路，但咪路仍以討厭依賴魔法的人類為由拒絕幫助小楓小楓只得自行努力對結木攝展開攻勢，但是

programme.title: 一起玩摺紙第2季:第20集
programme.desc: 想像一下！如果你手裡有一張足夠大的白紙，你的任務是把它摺疊51次那麼，它有多高？答案是：想像不到的高度藉由一張紙轉變成各種不同造型的作品，其過程經歷了思考組建邏輯，最終完成，持續性且連貫性的大腦運用，除了增進腦力靈活度，更是啟發孩子創造力思考力的最佳學習遊戲 由MOMO家族哥哥姐姐帶領小朋友一起動手玩摺紙，發揮想像力，體驗各式摺紙之遊戲樂趣

programme.title: 下課花路米-壯遊闖天下第31集
programme.desc: 在沒有爸媽的陪伴下，脫離舒適圈，在有限的經費下，學習自己規劃行程，深度探索神秘陌生的異國文化，挑戰自我極限，用心去感受這趟旅程帶來的可貴經驗，完成一趟不可思議的奇妙旅程...

programme.title: 動物大明星第7季:第2集
programme.desc: 逛完一趟動物園 爸爸：小寶，今天你認識了幾種動物呢？ 小寶：好多好多喔！有大象獅子老虎還有紅毛猩猩... 不過為什麼猴子的屁股會這麼紅啊？ 為什麼無尾熊要睡在樹上呢？ 為什麼長頸鹿不坐下來休息呢？ 為什麼貓頭鷹的脖子可以轉270度呢？為什麼為什麼為什麼 小寶的一百個疑問，誰來解答呢？ 動物園大明星是專為小朋友打造的動物節目，寫實記錄各種動 物生態，看動物褓母怎麼照顧牠們的生活起居 帶小朋友進入不一樣的動物世界，開啟他們廣闊的視野

programme.title: MOMO歡樂谷第11季:第11集
programme.desc: 最適合小朋友觀賞的優質兒童律動節目除了好聽的歌曲及好看的唱跳表演，還有哥哥和姐姐們的遊戲大PK另透過說故事的啟發引導兒童們，為兒童們解答生活上和人際關係上的眾多疑惑

programme.title: 寶貝星樂園第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 寶貝星樂園，歡樂總動員！MOMO親子台特地開闢一個園地，讓2-12歲的小朋友可以在寶貝星樂園展現他們的才藝，秀出他們的熱情大方可以看到唱歌舞蹈樂器演奏等等不同小朋友的才藝，還有小朋友表演時自信投入的表現，以及家長們陪同練習在旁加油的溫馨畫面等等，節目氣氛歡樂又熱鬧！除了 邀請專業的評審老師給予建議講評之外，每集也會選出最佳造型獎最佳人氣獎以及閃亮小明星獎給予鼓勵，也能為小朋友們留下一個快樂的童年回憶，歡迎2 -12歲的小朋友們踴躍報名參加！

programme.title: 紙箱做玩具第22集

programme.desc: 瑪莎是個充滿朝氣活力四射的小女孩，住在離森林不遠的小木屋裡有天意外地闖進住在森林的熊熊家，開始了充滿歡笑與奇妙的生活從馬戲團退休的熊熊，在森林裡度過了安穩平淡的退休生活，直到遇到了瑪莎，為他的生活增添了許多樂趣，從一開始害怕瑪莎的調皮搗蛋，到逐漸他們成為了最棒的朋友在他們的生活裡充滿著瑪莎的好奇心與熊熊對瑪莎悉心的教導與照顧 瑪莎與熊來自於俄羅斯的3D動畫，故事內容源自於俄羅斯的童話，在俄羅斯受到了大朋友與小朋友的歡迎，故事搬到現代的大螢幕中，更增添了許多冒險故事動畫中所呈現的音樂與內容都有著濃濃的俄羅斯風情，並透過立體3D的呈現方式帶來了視覺與聽覺上的饗宴 瑪莎與熊以輕

programme.title: Hello Kitty-Super Style！第19集

programme.desc: 某個神奇夜晚，一群獨角獸順著一顆流星劃過天際，墜入神秘的海洋，變成了半獨角獸半魚的奇幻生物有一天，當它們追逐遷徙的海豚時，他們首次發現了人類世界的水面從此，關於人魚獨角獸的傳說便流傳開來據說，它們只會在月食時現身

programme.title: 湯姆貓與傑利鼠第107集

programme.title: 豆豆先生第116集
programme.desc: 在大小銀幕上扮演豆豆先生的羅文亞特金Rowan Atkinson，這次將自己變身為卡通人物，並為這部動畫親自配音！本系列忠實呈現豆豆先生這個活在真實世界的角色，每一集中，我們不幸的豆豆先生，總要大費周章弄得灰頭土臉，才能完成一件簡單的小事，那包括找停車位讓鄰居安靜下來換沙發或是曬曬太陽等豆豆先生忠實的搭檔泰迪和邪惡的房東衛奇太太，以及她的獨眼貓史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾瑪也同台演出這部卡通影集已經在全球150個國家播出，曾經榮獲過國際艾美獎和蒙特婁金玫瑰獎的肯定，並引起豆豆先生的熱潮，改編成同名電影上映

programme.desc: 在成為叛逆無禮的經典樂一通動畫短片前，兔寶寶太菲鴨和死黨們都還是剛學走路的小小孩，天真無邪的好奇寶寶 特別為學齡前兒童設計的寶貝樂一通將為卡通迷們隆重介紹這些可愛討喜的小小明星；節目將以較小體型甜蜜討喜的方式呈現無比歡樂的經典卡通明星兔寶寶太菲鴨傻大鳥崔弟和大嘴怪在老婆婆充滿冒險行動的維多利亞式宅第中，可是一群鬼靈精怪的小搗蛋鬼 小兔寶寶和朋友們將邀請所有小小卡通迷，探索這個無奇不有的歡樂世界

programme.title: 人魚獨角獸-星落第108集
programme.desc: 某個神奇夜晚，一群獨角獸順著一顆流星劃過天際，墜入神秘的海洋，變成了半獨角獸半魚的奇幻生物有一天，當它們追逐遷徙的海豚時，他們首次發現了人類世界的水面從此，關於人魚獨角獸的傳說便流傳開來據說，它們只會在月食時現身

programme.title: 湯姆貓與傑利鼠第102集

programme.title: 豆豆先生第117集
programme.desc: 在大小銀幕上扮演豆豆先生的羅文亞特金Rowan Atkinson，這次將自己變身為卡通人物，並為這部動畫親自配音！本系列忠實呈現豆豆先生這個活在真實世界的角色，每一集中，我們不幸的豆豆先生，總要大費周章弄得灰頭土臉，才能完成一件簡單的小事，那包括找停車位讓鄰居安靜下來換沙發或是曬曬太陽等豆豆先生忠實的搭檔泰迪和邪惡的房東衛奇太太，以及她的獨眼貓史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾瑪也同台演出這部卡通影集已經在全球150個國家播出，曾經榮獲過國際艾美獎和蒙特婁金玫瑰獎的肯定，並引起豆豆先生的熱潮，改編成同名電影上映

programme.title: POLI第28集
programme.desc: 在美麗的布魯姆斯小鎮，有一群救援小英雄，分別是富有正義感的警車隊長-波力勇敢又可靠消防車-羅伊善良又聰明的救護車-安寶以及反應敏捷的直昇機-赫利為保護小鎮居民的安全，英勇的救援小隊將同心協力克服困難與危險幫助朋友們！跟著波力一起出發去救援吧！當朋友有需要幫助的時候，救援小隊就會適時地出現，用團隊合作及智慧來解決困難小朋友能從救援小隊幫助別人的行動中，學習日常生活中應該如何小心防範週遭事物，也從中學習到助人為快樂之本的道理以及和平的與他人共處的重要性，是放心讓孩子收看之優質動畫

programme.title: POLI第32集
programme.desc: 在美麗的布魯姆斯小鎮，有一群救援小英雄，分別是富有正義感的警車隊長-波力勇敢又可靠消防車-羅伊善良又聰明的救護車-安寶以及反應敏捷的直昇機-赫利為保護小鎮居民的安全，英勇的救援小隊將同心協力克服困難與危險幫助朋友們！跟著波力一起出發去救援吧！當朋友有需要幫助的時候，救援小隊就會適時地出現，用團隊合作及智慧來解決困難小朋友能從救援小隊幫助別人的行動中，學習日常生活中應該如何小心防範週遭事物，也從中學習到助人為快樂之本的道理以及和平的與他人共處的重要性，是放心讓孩子收看之優質動畫

programme.title: 一笑隨歌第30集

programme.title: 世上最漂亮的女兒第30集
programme.desc: 經營雪濃湯店的單親媽媽朴善子，含辛茹苦將三個女兒撫養長大大女兒姜美善是標準的職業婦女，在蠟燭兩頭燒的職場與家庭間疲於奔命，不僅要應付強勢挑剔的婆婆，還得將年幼的女兒託付給娘家媽媽照顧二女兒姜美莉是擁有高學歷與高薪的大企業行銷部長，為了不讓母親操心，美莉拚命工作，但在遇上新進職員韓泰柱後，不僅感情迎來轉變，隱藏在身世背後與親生母親的複雜糾葛也逐漸浮上檯面小女兒姜美慧曾是拿過文學獎的天才小說家，如今卻陷入漫長的創作低潮，只能暫時在媽媽的湯店裡幫忙打雜，尋找人生的下一個方向母女間時而爭吵時而相依為命的深厚羈絆，最堅強的後盾，就是媽媽?

programme.desc: 經營雪濃湯店的單親媽媽朴善子，含辛茹苦將三個女兒撫養長大大女兒姜美善是標準的職業婦女，在蠟燭兩頭燒的職場與家庭間疲於奔命，不僅要應付強勢挑剔的婆婆，還得將年幼的女兒託付給娘家媽媽照顧二女兒姜美莉是擁有高學歷與高薪的大企業行銷部長，為了不讓母親操心，美莉拚命工作，但在遇上新進職員韓泰柱後，不僅感情迎來轉變，隱藏在身世背後與親生母親的複雜糾葛也逐漸浮上檯面小女兒姜美慧曾是拿過文學獎的天才小說家，如今卻陷入漫長的創作低潮，只能暫時在媽媽的湯店裡幫忙打雜，尋找人生的下一個方向母女間時而爭吵時而相依為命的深厚羈絆，最堅強的後盾，就是媽媽?

programme.title: 因為沒有下輩子第11集
programme.desc: 三位四十多歲的女子，在可能被稱為歐巴桑的年紀裡，於育兒戰場與職場夾縫間掙扎，懷念年輕時的榮光，也在不安中重新審視自己有人想重返舞台有人為婚姻煩惱，也有人在光鮮亮麗的生活裡偷偷寂寞雖然她們已在人生半途，為追尋更好的自己而努力這是一部好友彼此扶持再次經歷成長痛的溫暖喜劇

programme.title: 花樣少年少女
programme.desc: 盧瑞莃是在美國長大的僑生，因幾年前在電視上看到跳高選手左以泉的跳高特輯，便開始崇拜他為了更了解泉，瑞莃便決心轉校到泉就讀的台灣櫻開學院，但由於櫻開是一所男子學校，瑞莃便扮成男生進入該學校就讀開學的第一天，瑞莃因為班機誤點而遲到慌慌張張的她像瘋了般飛奔跑進學校而撞上了泉，可是她還不知道她撞到的人就是泉瑞莃的書被撞至掉到整地都是，她匆忙地撿起了書本之後又飛奔而去，可是把書包遺留在地上到了教室之後，瑞莃才發現地丟了書包這時，泉走進來把書包丟在了瑞莃的懷裏，並諷刺地說：沒想到你腿短短的，跑起來還挺快的嘛下課後，瑞莃走到泉的面前，鞠了一躬後向泉表白她喜歡泉，並想和他做朋友泉的第一想法

programme.title: 書卷一夢
programme.desc: 18線女演員宋小魚意外穿越，成為劇本中必死的虐戀女主角宋一夢在大婚當天，她先是被千羽軍攔截，又被魔頭皇子南珩糾纏，三人陷入混亂的互刺局面為了逃避淒慘的命運，宋小魚嘗試反套路悔婚，卻導致系統Bug，深陷離奇死法的無限循環她必須在南珩的身邊，不斷挑戰並改變原本的虐心劇情

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 善良的恩星沒有心機，是個樂天派，但同時卻也很倔強十一歲時媽媽去世，在她堅強的外表下，其實常常感到孤單和空虛十六歲時由於爸爸再婚組成了新的家庭，然而繼母和妹妹的態度，讓她對家不再抱有希望愛吃東西的她，對於味覺異常敏銳，進而也對料理產生了興趣一個偶然的機會下，她救了食品財團的張淑子會長，因而成為遺產繼承人，從此她的人生有了新的變化

programme.title: 來自星星的事第15集
programme.desc: 來自星星的事是一部韓國浪漫奇幻劇，以異星人和地球女子之間的愛情故事為核心劇情講述了從400年前來自外星球的千年男子都敏俊（Do Min-joon）在地球上與現代女子千頌伊（Cheon Song-yi）相遇的故事都敏俊擁有特殊的能力，包括超凡的力量不老不死和超感官知覺，但他選擇遠離人類並過著孤獨的生活然而，當他遇到千頌伊時，他的生活開始發生改變，他們之間產生了一段跨越時空的愛情劇中探討了愛情犧牲命運和人性的主題，同時也帶有一些喜劇和懸疑的元素這部劇因其精湛的演技浪漫的劇情和視覺效果受到觀眾的喜愛，成為一部受歡迎的韓劇作品
